meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目新版本发布到 npm 并验证发布产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要一键把代码包发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version of your project to npm and verify the outputs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a code package to npm and confirm it succeeded

howto.what: 把 oh-my-opencode 正式发布到 npm：触发 GitHub Actions 发布工作流，验证 npm 包与 GitHub release，写好发布摘要并尝试发 Discord 公告。全程只做发布，不审查或修补代码。
howto.when: 用户说“publish”“release”“deploy”等发布相关词，并指定版本号变动类型（patch/minor/major）时触发；没给类型会先停下来询问。

say.text: 把 oh-my-opencode 发布一个 patch 版本
say.note: 触发一次 patch 级的 npm 发布。

say.text: 以 minor 版本发一个新功能版本
say.note: 触发 minor 级发布并产出功能摘要。

say.text: 执行 major 版本升级发布
say.note: 触发 major 级发布并产出完整发布说明。

howto.what_en: Triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow for oh-my-opencode, verifies the npm packages and GitHub release, writes an enhanced summary, and tries posting a Discord announcement. Ship-only: never reviews or fixes code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says 'publish', 'release', 'deploy', or similar, and names a bump type (patch, minor, or major). Without a bump type it stops and asks for one.

say_en.text: Publish a patch version of oh-my-opencode.
Do a minor release for the new features.
say_en.note: Triggers a minor bump with a feature summary.
Triggers a major bump with a full release narrative.
